name: Get Lead Field by Name
summary: Retrieves full metadata for a single lead field by its REST API name — type, length, description, whether it's custom.
whenToUse: When you need the details of one specific field (e.g. to confirm its type before syncing data to it).

path.name: fieldApiName
path.label: Field API name
path.hint: The field's REST API name (e.g. 'email', 'leadScore', or your custom field name).

response.description: One field's metadata: name, displayName, dataType, length, description, isCustom, readOnly.
